summary: Echoes II: The Lost Signals is an interactive space exploration game inspired by the "Abandoned, But Not Forgotten" challenge. Stepping into the treads of ECHO-7, an autonomous archive rover, you must track down humanity’s silent spacecraft across the Moon, Mars, and deep space before their fading signals vanish forever. By restoring these forgotten machines, you’ll uncover the engineering stories behind how they were built, launched, and what they discovered. Your mission: locate every lost probe and preserve their legacy in the Archive.
details: Inspired by the "Abandoned, But Not Forgotten" challenge, Echoes II: The Lost Signals is an interactive browser game where you control ECHO-7, an autonomous archival robot tasked with tracking down humanity’s silent spacecraft across the Moon, Mars, and deep space. By managing your battery and following fading signals, you restore lost machines to uncover how they were built and launched, unlock mission-themed arcade minigames, and build a permanent Archive backed by live NASA news and imagery. Built with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, the Canvas API, NASA Open APIs, AI-assisted development tools, and Netlify, the project transforms static space history into an emotional, accessible search-and-rescue experience—balancing engaging retro-terminal gameplay with strict educational accuracy, offline resilience, and dedicated resources for teachers and students.
